caption: The drawing shows a single, rectangular wooden bowl with rounded corners and slightly flared handles integrated into the two shorter sides. The bowl is depicted empty and angled so the viewer can see into the hollowed interior as well as the thickness of the bowl’s rim and base. The wood grain is visible with various shades of brown, from light tan to medium and darker brown, highlighting the texture and natural markings of the wood. There are faint shadows on the bowl’s interior and exterior, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects present. In the lower left part of the drawing, the name “Wellington Blewett” is written in small, simple text.
title: Chopping Bowl
